detected_fault: The beeping issue is related to the battery charging cycle, which can cause intermittent beeps when the battery level is around 40% or lower. The beeping becomes more frequent and intense during gaming due to the laptop's power-hungry nature.
suggested_solution: Update the graphics card drivers to the latest version (e.g., 460.64), check for BIOS updates and install the latest version (e.g., A515-53GQ_1.0.0), disable any unnecessary startup programs or services that may be causing the beeping, and consider using a third-party battery calibration tool to reset the battery's charging cycle.
